text:
**It is not possible to tell whether clearing is still happening today.** The evidence identifies about 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property in 2021, but does not report whether additional loss occurred in later years, even though the data series extends through 2025.

Most of the affected area was mapped as planted pine forest. Tree-cover loss could reflect plantation harvesting or another cause; it does not by itself establish permanent deforestation or land-use change.
